name: Bülstedt (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bülstedt (a white wavy bend, a church and a wheel on green).
history: Municipal flag of Bülstedt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bülstedt arms — wavy bend, church and wheel on green
